description:
About Our Brand and Products

J&K Jerky is a premium beef jerky brand focused on bold flavor, thick cuts, and high-quality ingredients. Our jerky is made from real cuts of beef and brisket, seasoned with unique flavor profiles ranging from classic originals to sweet, spicy, and smoky blends. We offer a variety of 7oz bags and bundles designed for people who want a satisfying, protein-packed snack without sacrificing flavor.

What Makes Us Different

Not all jerky is the same. Many brands use thin pieces or “jerky shake.” At J&K Jerky, we focus on thick, meaty slabs with real texture and bold seasoning. Our brisket jerky is especially known for being tender and flavorful, giving customers a premium jerky experience that stands out from typical gas station or grocery store options.

How Affiliates Can Earn

Affiliates earn commission by sharing their unique referral link or discount code. Every time a customer makes a purchase through your link or code, you earn a percentage of the sale. We also provide affiliates with product launches, special promotions, and exclusive offers to help maximize earning potential.

How to Promote Us

Affiliates can promote J&K Jerky through social media posts, videos, reviews, blog content, newsletters, or other creative formats. Many of our top partners share unboxing videos, taste tests, recipe ideas, or snack recommendations with their audience. Authentic content that shows the product experience tends to perform best.

Other Information

Once approved, affiliates will receive their unique tracking link or discount code along with resources to help promote the brand. We encourage affiliates to stay authentic to their voice and audience while showcasing the product in a way that feels natural. Our team is always available to support collaborations, answer questions, and provide updates on new products or promotions.
